changelog: Show Poster now respects explicit choices instead of switching itself back on.
Artwork results cannot replace newer playback, image settings or webhook configuration.
Webhook artwork caching expires safely; stale uploads are cancelled without blocking player/settings lifecycle.
Unchanged playback retries temporary artwork failures with capped backoff and refreshes expired images.
Idle image URLs use the artwork resolver, and the provider-URL diagnostic now reaches the presence payload.
Broadcast watching activity is cleared correctly when playback ends without a supported idle transport.
ATTENTION: Webhook upload and CDN retrieval are verified. Physical Discord-client rendering still requires device confirmation.
message: v731 - RPC artwork lifecycle and webhook cache fixes
